bugs_found: compound_interest uses multiplication '* (n * t)' instead of exponentiation '** (n * t)', producing incorrect compounding result
compound_interest does not validate negative principal
apply_fee computes fee as a*pct without dividing by 100, treating fee_pct as a fraction while the parameter name suggests a percentage (ambiguous/likely incorrect)
fx_convert lacks validation that the rate is positive (a zero or negative rate would silently produce wrong results)
loan_payment returns p/m as a Decimal division when r==0 without quantization, and elsewhere divisions can yield non-terminating Decimals raising InvalidOperation under non-default contexts
transfer mutates balances without atomicity/locking; not thread-safe and not rolled back on partial failure
Account/Receipt dataclasses accept Decimal but no type enforcement; callers passing float can introduce precision errors
No rounding/quantization to currency precision (e.g., 2 decimals) in compound_interest, loan_payment, apply_fee, fx_convert
